review_basis: Read the index-specific opening sentence in each exact historical release paragraph, distinguishing monthly percent change from index-point change, annual comparison and component commodity movements. Missing or approximately unchanged without a numerical percentage stays null.
mapping_scope: International commodity-basket momentum proxies. Cereal is a broad basket including maize, not a corn-only index; vegetable oils are a broad basket, not a coconut-only series; Meat covers poultry, pig, bovine and ovine meat. No regional source weights or domestic pass-through coefficient is asserted. Fish, Fruits and Vegetables receive no sector feature. Dairy has no matching category in the evaluated panel.
vintage_policy: Preserve the monthly percentage as reported in that archived release, including comparisons against prior values already revised at that time. Never substitute later revised datasets. Meat estimates can combine observed and projected prices.

explicit_exclusions.2022-04/Cereal: Index change is 0.7 points; the 3.0 percent decline applies to maize, not the cereal index.
explicit_exclusions.2023-02/Cereal: Virtually unchanged is not an exact zero.
explicit_exclusions.2023-02/Meat: Almost unchanged is not an exact zero.
explicit_exclusions.All Rice: Absent named index or non-numeric change remains missing; do not substitute cereal change.
